title: My two children
instructions: Ayşe iki çocuğunu anlatıyor. Hangi bilginin hangi çocuğa ait olduğunu karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: s
script.text: My husband and I have two children, a son and a daughter.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Our son, Can, is twelve. He is tall and has short black hair. He loves football and plays every Saturday.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Our daughter, Defne, is eight. She has long brown hair. She loves animals and wants to be a vet.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Can is good at maths, but he is not very good at English.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Defne is good at English and art.

script.speaker: s
script.text: They are very different, but they are good friends.

script.speaker: s
script.text: In the evening, Can helps Defne with maths, and Defne helps Can with English!

questions.feedback: Can on iki yaşında; Defne sekiz.

questions.prompt: What does Defne want to be?

questions.feedback: Can matematikte iyi, İngilizcede pek iyi değil.
